description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model in terms of Word Error Rate (WER) over a series of epochs during fine-tuning. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 1 to 6, and is labeled "epoch." The y-axis measures the WER, ranging from 30 to 70, and is labeled "WER." The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of the Whisper model: tiny AdaLoRA_int4, tiny AdaLoRA_int8, tiny int4, tiny int8, and tiny full. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line is represented by a solid line with square markers, the tiny AdaLoRA_int8 by a dashed line with diamond markers, the tiny int4 by a dash-dot line with triangle markers, the tiny int8 by a dotted line with circle markers, and the tiny full by a dash-dot-dot line with star markers. The lines show a general trend of decreasing WER as the number of epochs increases, indicating an improvement in model performance over time. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 configuration starts with the highest WER at epoch 1 and ends with the lowest WER at epoch 6, while the tiny full configuration starts with the lowest WER and maintains a relatively stable performance throughout the epochs.
